{{Quote|Captain Rigel, Imperial Conquest Consolidation Corps. When the Empire invades, we're the ones who seal the deal.|Rigel|<ref name="OPB" />}}
The '''Imperial Conquest Consolidation Corps''', or the '''ICCC''', was a division of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was tasked with securing newly-conquered [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and unruly populations. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Vrain]] headed the ICCC, and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rigel (captain)|Rigel]] was assigned to the planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="BTR" /> The [[Sphere of Military Strategy]] controlled the ICCC.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
